The '''All Terrain Missile Platform (AT-MP)''' was a bipedal walker similar to the standard [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]].

==Description==
Despite its stunted appearance compared to the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], the AT-MP more than compensated for its awkward proportions with its firepower, which consisted of 8 [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and a centrally-mounted rotary [[Chaingun/Legends|chaingun]].

==History==
The AT-MP was in service by [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel forces]] encountering them at the [[Battle of Corrdair]]. The somewhat comical appearance of the AT-MP was initially a source of amusement for the Rebels. However the Rebels stopped laughing when the AT-MPs unleashed their missiles.<ref name="FU2" />

[[File:AT-MP_Starkiller.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] attacks an AT-MP.]]

When the clone Marek landed on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] at [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]], several AT-MPs were dispatched by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] to attack the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], but were destroyed when their missiles were deflected back at them by Marek during his attempt to rescue his predecessor's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] mentor, [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]].

Marek also encountered AT-MPs during the [[Assault on Kamino]]. AT-STs and AT-MPs were brought on board the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']] through the use of [[Imperial Boarding Pod]]s which clamped themselves on the side of the ''Salvation'', but Marek destroyed them all. He also faced them in [[Timira City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in his search for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the captured [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].

==Behind the scenes==
The AT-MP bears a resemblance to the [[Clone Personal Walker]] from ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' - the cockpit area in particular - which may indicate the AT-MP is descended from that design.
